items.title: Universal Music Sues DistroKid for Copyright Infringement and Deceptive Trade Practices, Says the Distributor ‘Is Flooding Platforms With AI-Generated Slop’
items.summary: Today in high-profile industry litigation: A firmly worded complaint filed by Universal Music Group (UMG) against DistroKid, which the major label says “is engaged in both deceptive trade practices and blatant copyright infringement.” UMG submitted the 52-page action to a Delaware federal court today, and as many will…

items.title: Suno estrena sus modelos v6 con Warner, BMG y Believe
items.summary: Suno, una de las principales plataformas de música con inteligencia artificial y objeto de demandas por derechos de autor en varios frentes, ha lanzado su suite de modelos v6, la primera que la compañía desarrolla con socios de la industria: Warner Music Group, BMG y Believe. Con este estreno, la firma retira simultáne…

items.title: Landmark termination rights ruling not the “copyright emergency” music publishers claim, songwriter tells US Supreme Court
items.summary: When America’s Fifth Circuit Appeals Court backed a songwriter-friendly interpretation of the termination right in US copyright law, the majors bought the song that prompted that ruling and asked the Supreme Court to intervene. The writer of that song has now urged the top court to not get involved

items.title: UMG demanda a DistroKid por ‘slop’ de IA y violación de derechos de autor
Cyril Vetter Formally Opposes the Major Labels’ ‘Off Base’ Supreme Court Appeal Amid High-Stakes Copyright Recapture Showdown
items.summary: Songwriter Cyril Vetter is firing back against the major labels’ aggressive push to bring their high-stakes copyright recapture case before the Supreme Court. The Louisiana-born “Double Shot (Of My Baby’s Love)” co-writer Vetter just recently laid out his opposition arguments across 37 detailed pages, after the majors…

items.title: Universal and Warner press court to end US musicians’ lawsuit over Udio, Suno deals
items.summary: The case rests on Article 21(a) of the Sound Recording Labor Agreement, the union's collective bargaining agreement with the record companies. Source

items.title: UMG firma un acuerdo global de IA con ElevenLabs
items.summary: Universal Music Group (UMG) ha firmado un acuerdo de licencia plurianual con ElevenLabs, la compañía de inteligencia artificial de audio valorada en 11.000 millones de dólares. Es el primer pacto de ElevenLabs con una gran discográfica y contempla el lanzamiento de una nueva plataforma de música con IA para fans, ademá…

items.title: Suno lanza un nuevo modelo de IA para música tras múltiples demandas por derechos de autor
Will You Please Stop Suing Us Now? Suno Turns a Legit Leaf With ‘v6’ as Warner Music’s Kyncl Leads the Licensed AI Pep Rally
items.summary: Moments after announcing a Believe partnership deal, Suno is now rolling out its Warner Music- and BMG-backed v6 models – with an eye on expanding into “opt-in experiences built around individual artists.” The sudden shift marks a big departure from earlier, non-licensed content grabs, but is it too late for Suno to sh…

items.title: BMI launches free service to help US songwriters and composers find healthcare coverage
items.summary: Called BMI Health Connect, the service has been created in collaboration with Gallagher Alternative Health Solutions, an insurance brokerage. Source

items.title: Believe and TuneCore won’t feed music to Suno without giving artists choice to opt in: ‘The artist must consent first, period.’
items.summary: Denis Ladegaillerie details two-stage opt-in process for artists who want (and don't want) to have their music provided to Suno Source

items.title: SubmitHub bans AI-generated music from its promotion services
items.summary: Earlier this year, music-promo platform SubmitHub revealed research suggesting that 23.2% of the tracks being submitted were fully AI-generated. The post is from Music Ally .

tip.title: Lee los términos del generador de IA que usas
tip.body: Cada plataforma decide por contrato qué puedes hacer comercialmente con lo que generas y qué derechos se reserva. Dos herramientas parecidas pueden darte licencias completamente distintas.

tip.title: Read the terms of the AI generator you use
tip.body: Each platform decides by contract what you may do commercially with your outputs and what rights it keeps. Two similar tools can grant completely different licenses.
